person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating third person, shifting focalization among characters while retaining third-person narration. Multiple interior quote passages independently show sustained he/she narration with access to character consciousness, agreeing with the authorized opening and the whole-book structural source. First-person forms occur in speech or direct thought, generic you appears in focalized or gnomic material, and the isolated authorial we in q00765 does not make the narrator a story participant. No sustained first- or second-person section was found. The main residual limitation is that the authorized publisher excerpt covers only the opening, but the explicit whole-book analysis and varied interior quotations resolve that scope limitation.
